title: Virtual Compute: billing timezone
content:
## Meaning — billing timezone

Virtual Compute billing timezone: Timezone used for calendar boundaries; IANA timezone string.

## Tier values — billing timezone

Northbridge Virtual Compute 2 vCPU — billing timezone: UTC.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 4 vCPU — billing timezone: UTC.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 8 vCPU — billing timezone: UTC.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 16 vCPU — billing timezone: UTC.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 32 vCPU — billing timezone: UTC.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 64 vCPU — billing timezone: UTC.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for billing timezone?**

Every listed Virtual Compute tier has billing timezone of UTC.

## Meaning — billing cycle

Virtual Compute billing cycle: Recurring invoice window basis; string.

## Tier values — billing cycle

Northbridge Virtual Compute 2 vCPU — billing cycle: calendar month.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 4 vCPU — billing cycle: calendar month.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 8 vCPU — billing cycle: calendar month.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 16 vCPU — billing cycle: calendar month.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 32 vCPU — billing cycle: calendar month.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 64 vCPU — billing cycle: calendar month.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for billing timezone?**

Every listed Virtual Compute tier has billing cycle of calendar month.
